posts.title: Kearney and Trecker (K&T) 2K Universal Milling Machine and Tooling for Sale - $3500
posts.text: This milling machine was made in about 1945 and is in pretty good shape. All the feeds and speeds work as does the rapid advance. It comes with a vertical head, both arbor supports, quite a few cutters, arbors, an ER40 collet arbor, a Van Norman swivel vise, two clamp sets, and a custom rolling dolly. Oil has been changed and the column filter is now an off the shelf item. The motor has been serviced at a motor shop (windings dipped and baked, new bearings) and the starter replaced and... Everything works — hook it up and go to work.
